name: fno_darcy
_comment: FNO-paper Darcy flow (Li et al. 2020) as released by the NeuralOperator team (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.12784353, darcy_test_128.pt converted to .npz with X = x, Y = y flattened 128 x 128). The release is NORMALISED: x in {0, 1} stands for a in {3, 12} (a = 3 + 9x, undone here by the affine map) and y is z-scored (u = sigma y + mu with unknown scalars, which the operator fit absorbs: L(const) = 0 and the scale is the fitted a). f = 1. The 128 grid is a strided subsample of the 421 grid the PDE was solved on, so the discrete operator matches only approximately.
